body.purpose: Public Sans editor and form text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact action with the shipped hover cascade and focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));border-radius:var(--radius,6px);padding:7px 12px;background:var(--surface, oklch(99% 0.005 100));color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));font:14px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,140ms) ease-out;background:var(--accent, oklch(36% 0.065 160));color:var(--on-accent, #fff);border-color:var(--accent, oklch(36% 0.065 160));}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--wash, oklch(92% 0.03 145));filter:brightness(1.12);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a26900);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Compact action with the shipped hover cascade and focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));border-radius:var(--radius,6px);padding:7px 12px;background:var(--surface, oklch(99% 0.005 100));color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));font:14px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,140ms) ease-out;}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--wash, oklch(92% 0.03 145));}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a26900);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Stacked label and opaque native field.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;font:550 13px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160))}.ds-field input{font:400 14px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;background:var(--surface, oklch(99% 0.005 100));color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));border-radius:var(--radius,6px);padding:10px;caret-color:var(--accent, oklch(36% 0.065 160))}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, oklch(46% 0.023 160))}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a26900);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Dock Tabs
components.description: Selected panel uses wash and an accent underline; preview is static.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140))}.ds-tabs button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));border-radius:var(--radius,6px);padding:7px 12px;background:var(--surface, oklch(99% 0.005 100));color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));font:14px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,140ms) ease-out;border:0;border-radius:0;flex:1;background:transparent;font-size:13px;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:var(--wash, oklch(92% 0.03 145))}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--wash, oklch(92% 0.03 145));border-bottom-color:var(--accent, oklch(36% 0.065 160))}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a26900);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Role Badge
components.description: Supplementary role text rather than color-only status.
components.css: .ds-badge{font:11px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));padding:4px 7px;border-radius:4px;text-transform:capitalize;white-space:nowrap} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Dialog Panel
components.description: Opaque dialog container; the source uses both app and native-dialog wrappers.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient feedback uses an inverted palette.

components.name: Frame Row
components.description: Flexible named frame action with adjacent controls.
components.css: .ds-frame{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-frame button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line, oklch(84% 0.018 140));border-radius:var(--radius,6px);padding:7px 12px;background:var(--surface, oklch(99% 0.005 100));color:var(--ink, oklch(27% 0.035 160));font:14px "Public Sans Variable",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,140ms) ease-out;}.ds-frame button:first-child{flex:1;justify-content:flex-start}.ds-frame button:hover{background:var(--wash, oklch(92% 0.03 145))}.ds-frame button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a26900);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
Canvas uses the architecture studio critique as its visual world: warm drawing paper, forest ink and compact workshop controls leave the authored board in charge. The connection screen introduces the workspace with a literary serif; the editor uses restrained sans-serif labels and familiar tools.

The system is dense around the edges and open in the center. Floating tools are opaque and lightly lifted; docks use a single dividing line. Fonts are bundled locally for offline use.
keyCharacteristics: Open canvas with compact perimeter tools.
Opaque surfaces, visible focus and redundant identity labels.

rules.name: The Canvas First Rule
rules.body: Keep persistent controls at the perimeter; the board occupies the remaining workspace.

rules.name: The Readable Identity Rule
rules.body: Pair participant color with initials and an accessible full name; use visible names in participant lists.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Use the shared soft shadow for floating tools and overlays; resting docks and rows use borders.

dos: Do use semantic palette roles so light, dark and high contrast stay coordinated.
Do preserve the visible focus outline and reduced-motion override.
Do keep fonts local and use SVG icons with accessible labels.
Do keep drawing colors distinct from interface status colors.
donts: Don't add glass decoration, ornamental gradients or emoji icons.
Don't use color as the only participant or connection-state cue.
Don't nest decorative cards around the canvas or introduce network fonts.
